definition: an ornamental line, engraved on a wall.
example_en: A beautiful ornamental line was engraved on the wall.

definition: the arrangement and mode of attachment of placenta or of placentas and foetus; placentation.
example_en: The doctor examined the pregnant woman's placentation.

definition: a thick cover.
example_en: A thick cover had been placed over the well.

definition: (masc.) one who has a dream or dreams.
example: ಆ ಕನಸುಗ ರಾತ್ರಿಯೆಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಚಿತ್ರ ಕನಸು ಕಂಡನು.
example_en: That dreamer saw strange dreams all night.

definition: a long, narrow root between hills or mountains.
example_en: A long narrow root was seen between the hills.

definition: the early part of the day, esp. around dawn; morning.
example_en: The chirping of birds was heard in the early morning.

definition: to find the integral of.
example_en: The student found the integral of the equation.

definition: a unit of measuring volume, in which the volume equals to one foot each of height, length and breadth or equal to the product of these; a cubic foot (i.e. equal to 1,728 cubic inches).
example: ಆ ಟ್ಯಾಂಕಿನ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ ನೂರು ಘನ ಅಡಿ.
example_en: The capacity of that tank is a hundred cubic feet.

definition: a unit of land measure equal to 160 square rods or 43,560 square feet (0.405 hectare); an acre.
example: ರೈತನ ಬಳಿ ಹತ್ತು ಎಕರೆ ಜಮೀನು ಇದೆ.
example_en: The farmer owns ten acres of land.

definition: to make a vocal sound.
example_en: The rooster made a vocal sound in the morning.

definition: to lose one's form; to become deformed or disfigured.
example_en: The flower lost its form in the sun.

definition: to cause to wake from or as from sleep.
example_en: As soon as the light fell, they woke him up.

definition: to be afraid of; to fear.
example_en: Left alone in the dark, the boy became very afraid.

definition: a taking care of another a respectable or elder person or of the sick, injure, etc.; a diligent and attentive service.
example: ಅವಳು ವೃದ್ಧ ತಂದೆಯ ಸೇವನದಲ್ಲಿ ತನ್ನ ದಿನಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳೆದಳು.
example_en: She spent her days in the attentive service of her aged father.

definition: to be deceived, cheated.
example_en: He was deceived in the trade and lost his money.

definition: a swing big enough for a person to sleep on; a swing-cot.
example: ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯ ರಾತ್ರಿ ಅವನು ಆಂದೋಳಪರಿಯಂಕದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಲಗಿದನು.
example_en: On a summer night he slept on the swing-cot.

definition: a man who fishes for his living; a fisherman.
example: ನಗಲಿಕ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಬಲೆಯನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತು ಕಡಲಿಗೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: The fisherman carried his net to the sea in the morning.

definition: the state of being branched or having branches.
example_en: The branching of that tree was dense.

definition: a line in which persons or things or arranged (in an order).
example_en: The students stood arranged in a line.

definition: (beard) to grow.
example_en: His beard began to grow.

definition: any thing that has venom (as a snake, esp.Ādi Śeṣa).
example: ವಿಸವಂತವಾದ ಆ ಸರ್ಪ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That venomous snake struck fear in everyone.

definition: the quality of being firmly resolved, determined; firmness of the mind; resoluteness.
example_en: The child stubbornly insisted that it wanted the toy.

definition: arrogance; conceit; disdain; contempt.
example: ಸಿರಿವಂತಿಕೆ ಬಂದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಹೊಂಗು ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: After he became wealthy, arrogance came upon him.

definition: a superficial wound caused by scratching with a nail or nails.
example_en: The scratch wound left by the cat has still not healed.

definition: absence of orderliness; disorder; chaos.
example_en: All the things inside the house were lying in disorder.

definition: that (as a building, room, etc.) which is provided with a good ventilation system.
example: ಆ ಹೊಸ ಕಟ್ಟಡ ಉತ್ತಮ ಹವಾಸೀರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಹೊಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: That new building has a good ventilation system.

definition: a bending or stooping forward.
example_en: The old man's forward stoop was clearly noticeable.

definition: at what time or period; when.
example_en: He asked when you would come.

definition: (dial.) that which is ground into paste, esp. coconut, chillies, etc.
example: ಅಮ್ಮ ಅರಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದ ತೆಂಗಿನಕಾಯಿ ಚಟ್ನಿ ರುಚಿಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The coconut chutney that mother ground into a paste was tasty.

definition: the behaviour or an act of a hoodlum; hoodlumism; goondaism; roguery.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗರ ಪುಂಡಾಟ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತೊಂದರೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The hoodlumism of those boys caused trouble in the village.

definition: the ball-shaped part of the eye, that moves in the socket of the eye.
example_en: Her eyeball moved quickly from side to side.

definition: to build; to construct.
example: ಸರ್ಕಾರ ಆ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಸೇತುವೆಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The government constructed a new bridge at that place.

definition: the process of casting of one's vote in an election and sending it through postal system by an officer who is away on government duty, from his normal place of working ; postal voting.
example: ಸೈನಿಕರು ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದೂ ಅಂಚೆಮತದಾನದ ಮೂಲಕ ಮತ ಚಲಾಯಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The soldiers, though at the border, cast their votes through postal voting.

definition: that part of an army which moves on either of the two sides; the flank of an army.
example_en: The army's flank fell upon the enemy simultaneously.

definition: to look desolated, abandoned or deserted.
example_en: The old fort looks desolated.

definition: any one of a series of moments at which the same or nearly the same thing recurs; time.
example_en: Once upon a time, he had come to the village.

definition: the administration of a city.
example_en: The city administration gave more attention to cleanliness.

definition: to make weak; to lessen the strength of; to weaken.
example_en: Poverty weakened his mental strength.

definition: a kind of urinary disease in men.
example_en: That man had the urinary disease called chilaku.

definition: a bed or couch.
example_en: The soldier rested his tiredness lying on the couch.

definition: a confused testimony or witness.
example_en: His statement in the court was a confused testimony.

definition: a particular breed of oxen.
example_en: These kuṇḍalavāḍi oxen are very strong.

definition: any reduction in expense, time, material, labour etc.; money saved from spending; the excess of income over expenditure; saving or savings; that which is preserved for future use.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳ ಉಳಿತಾಯದಿಂದ ಅವನು ಮನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He built a house out of his monthly savings.

definition: the early stage of youth.
example_en: That young man was at the threshold of early youth.

definition: in a moderately cold condition; coolly.
example_en: The morning breeze was blowing coolly.

definition: any tailless, stout-bodied amphibian of the order Anura, including the smooth, moist-skinned frog species that live in a damp or semiaquatic habitat and the warty, drier-skinned toad species that are mostly terrestrial as adults; a frog.
example_en: During the rainy season, frogs were croaking all over the pond.

definition: any alcoholic liquor that intoxicates.
example_en: He drank the intoxicating liquor and lost consciousness.

definition: the time or period during which something gets or is changed or undergoes mutation.
example_en: During that period of transition, many laws changed.

definition: a series of interconnected troubles, dificulties or defeats.
example: ಆ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಲ, ರೋಗ ಎಂಬ ಕವಲ್ಬನ್ನ ಬಂದೊದಗಿತು.
example_en: A series of interconnected troubles like debt and illness befell that family.

definition: the ovum of birds, reptiles, fishes and many of the invertebrates, usu. enclosed in a spheroidal shell and containing the embryo of a new individual; an egg.
example_en: The hen laid an egg.

definition: a ray or beam of light.
example_en: The sun's ray shone upon the water.

definition: to prosper; to thrive well; to progress.
example_en: Through hard work, that business prospered.

definition: brilliant lustre.
example: ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚಿನ್ನದ ತನಿವೊಗರ್ ಕಣ್ಣು ಕೋರೈಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the sunlight the brilliant lustre of the gold was dazzling.

definition: spread or scattered over; covering a relatively wider area.
example_en: The clouds were spread widely across the sky.

definition: Pārvati, who is holding a trident.
example_en: Devotees praised Parvati, the trident-holder.

definition: the plant Dolichos lablab (= Lablab niger) of Papilionaeae family.
example: ಕಟ್ಟವರೆ ಬಳ್ಳಿ ಬೇಲಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಬ್ಬಿ ಬೆಳೆದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The bean vine had grown spreading over the fence.

definition: cattle excrement used to fertilise soil; manure.
example: ಹೊಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸಗಣಿಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಹಾಕಿದ ನಂತರ ಬೆಳೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಬಂತು.
example_en: After applying cattle manure to the field, the crop grew well.

definition: a woven fabric of fibrous material used for covering the body; cloth.
example_en: She wore a new cloth.

definition: transparent, colourless or slightly tinged quartz; a crystal.
example_en: A piece of crystal was found on the riverbank.

definition: absolute darkness.
example_en: Absolute darkness had descended inside the cave.

definition: flattery or cajoling pursuasion.
example_en: She was captivated hearing his flattering talk.

definition: to make smooth or level with or as with a plane; to smoothen, taper or thin.
example_en: The carpenter smoothened the wooden plank by planing it.

definition: a wrong statement; a deceiving speech; act of lying.
example_en: His deceptive statement was soon exposed.

definition: a drawing or other representation, on a flat surface, of all or part of the earth's surface ordinarily showing countries, bodies of water, cities, mountains, etc.; a map.
example_en: The teacher hung a map on the wall.

definition: the act or fact of dying; a coming to a permanent end of all life; death.
example_en: He met his death due to illness.

definition: not beaten; unhurt.
example: ಆ ಅಪ್ರಹತ ಸೈನಿಕ ಯುದ್ಧದಿಂದ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿ ಮರಳಿದನು.
example_en: That unhurt soldier returned safely from the war.

definition: an agreement entered between two person regarding salary, remuneration, wages, rent, the task to be done, etc.
example_en: The two of them made an agreement about the rent.

definition: the front portion.
example_en: The king stood at the front portion of the army.

definition: a man who follows another's beliefs, teachings, etc.
example: ಗುರುಗಳ ಹಿಂಬಾಲಕ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಅವರ ಬೋಧನೆ ಹರಡಿದನು.
example_en: The guru's follower spread his teachings everywhere.

definition: with a violent gush (of water).
example_en: Water gushed violently from the broken pipe.

definition: a member of a contingent of foot-soldiers; a foot-soldier.
example_en: The foot-soldiers obeyed the king's command.

definition: very young shoots of a creeper, branch of a plant, that is red in colour.
example: ಬಳ್ಳಿಯ ಕೆಂಗುಡಿ ಚಿಗುರಿ ಸೂರ್ಯನ ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The creeper's red young shoot sprouted and glowed in the sunlight.

definition: (dial.) a bunch of areca nuts or coconuts.
example: ಅವನು ಒಂದು ಕೈಲು ಅಡಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಒಯ್ದನು.
example_en: He carried a bunch of areca nuts to the market.

definition: a flat piece of metal, bearing an inscription or design given as a reward for bravery, merit, etc.; a medal.
example_en: The soldier was given a medal for his brave act.

definition: a long shaft with a pointed end used for piercing; a spear.
example_en: Shiva holds a trident-spear in his hand.

definition: a touching, rubbing softly (chiefly with one's palm).
example: ಅವಳ ಕೈಯ ತೀಟ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಸಂತೋಷ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The gentle rubbing of her hand brought joy to the child.

definition: a vow taken by a servant or soldier that he also would die following the death of his master.
example_en: The soldier took the vow to follow his master in death.

definition: the thistle plant Argemone mexicana of Papaveraceae family; gamboge thistle.
example_en: The leaves of the thistle plant are full of thorns.

definition: a paste applied to the central part of the skin or parchment of percussion instruments like Mridanga, tabala.
example: ಮೃದಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಕರ್ಣ ಹಚ್ಚಿದ ನಂತರ ಶಬ್ದ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After the paste was applied to the mridanga's skin, the sound became clear.

definition: moral or religious righteousness.
example_en: The Buddha gave the teaching of righteousness (dhamma) to the people.

definition: that which is devoid of consciousness; a mundane and inert object.
example: ಕಲ್ಲು ಒಂದು ಅಚಿತ್ತು ವಸ್ತು ಎಂದು ಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The scripture says a stone is an inert, unconscious object.

definition: a military attack.
example: ಆ ಕೋಟೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮೋಹಿಂ ನಡೆದದ್ದು ಇತಿಹಾಸದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
example_en: The military attack on that fort is famous in history.

definition: the exact or essential fact or idea under consideration; a point.
example_en: The point of his statement was understood by everyone.

definition: a person of extraordinary valour, courage.
example: ಆ ಹುರಿಯಾಳು ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಎದುರು ಧೈರ್ಯದಿಂದ ನಿಂತನು.
example_en: That valorous man stood bravely before the enemies.

definition: that happens, recurs every day or regularly.
example_en: This is a worship that happens every day regularly.

definition: the condition of being struck with wonder, surprise, admiration, etc.
example: ಆ ದೃಶ್ಯವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಅವನಿಗೆ ದಂಗು ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing that sight, he was struck with wonder.

definition: the quality or fact of being true.
example_en: There was truth in his words.

definition: that which is full of juice or sap.
example_en: This fruit is full of sweet juice.

definition: a small, usu. hard, tumorous growth on the skin, caused by a virus; a wart.
example_en: The doctor removed the wart by surgery.

definition: the structure made or the place chosen by birds for sheltering themselves and for laying their eggs; a nest.
example: ಪಕ್ಷಿಗಳು ಮರದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಲಾಯ ಕಟ್ಟಿ ಮೊಟ್ಟೆ ಇಟ್ಟವು.
example_en: The birds built a nest on the tree branch and laid eggs.

definition: the housework as sweeping, cleaning the kitchen vessels, etc.
example: ಅವಳು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಕಸಮುಸುರೆ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: She finishes the housework of sweeping and cleaning every morning.

definition: a daring undertaking that is very hazardous.
example_en: Climbing that mountain is a very hazardous undertaking.

definition: a man who, wearing odd dresses, acts funny in a drama with an intention of rousing laughter.
example_en: That comic actor's antics made the audience laugh.

definition: the fact of being outgrown or unmanageable.
example: ಮಗು ಅಸಕೞಿಹಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿ ತಾಯಿಯ ಕೈಯಿಂದ ಜಾರಿತು.
example_en: The child, having become unmanageable, slipped out of its mother's hands.

definition: the fact or condition of being autonomous; self-government; independence; autonomy.
example_en: That state fought for its autonomy.

definition: flat disk of candied lac.
example_en: The children ate the candied lac disk as a sweet snack.

definition: permanently; eternally; .
example_en: His friendship remains permanently.

definition: an assemblage of poets.
example_en: An assemblage of poets had gathered at that gathering.

definition: the country Ethiopia (formerly known as Abyssinia) in northeast Africa.
example_en: The country of Ethiopia is in the continent of Africa.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being wrinkled, contracted.
example_en: The wrinkled, shrivelled state of the dried fruit was clearly visible.

definition: pain in or near a tooth; toothache.
example_en: He could not sleep all night because of the toothache.

definition: to roll oneself and lie on one's belly.
example_en: The child rolled over and lay on its belly on the bed.

definition: a person working under another; a subordinate official, worker or employee.
example: ಅವನು ಆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯ ಕೆಳಗೆ ತಾಬೇದಾರನಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He works as a subordinate under that officer.

definition: a patting gently (as on the body of a child to make it sleep).
example: ತಾಯಿ ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಧಿಮುಕ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾ ನಿದ್ರೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother gently patted the child to put it to sleep.

definition: the instruments, materials, tools, etc. having a particular use or needed for a specific use; an apparatus.
example_en: He bought all the tools that the carpenter needed.

definition: the fibrous plant, Linum usitatissimum of Linaceae family with delicate, blue flowers, the seeds of which (linseeds) are used to make linseed oil, and the fibres of the stem are spun into linen thread; flax.
example_en: The farmers sowed flax in the field.

definition: either of two bones, the mandible or maxilla, forming the framework of the mouth and hold teeth; a jaw.
example_en: The fish's jaw has sharp teeth.

definition: any smooth, powdery material (as ashes, smooth earth, etc.) used to wash kitchen dishes.
example_en: They washed the kitchen dishes with the scouring powder.

definition: to be eaten of infected by worms; to become putrid or rotten; to be decomposed; to putrefy.
example_en: The rice left in the sun became rotten.

definition: the quality or fact of being abnormally thin; thinness.
example_en: His body became weak due to thinness.

definition: a strip of cloth, esp. gauze or other dressing used to bind or cover an injured part of the body; a bandage.
example_en: The nurse bandaged the wound.

definition: a kind of highly infectious disease of lungs; a dangerous pulmonary consumption.
example_en: Consumption of the lungs was once a fatal disease.

definition: a kind of bird .
example: ಕೆರೆಯ ಬಳಿ ತಿಚುಕ ಪಕ್ಷಿಗಳ ಗುಂಪು ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: A flock of ticuka birds was seen near the lake.

definition: a wandering for alms.
example_en: The mendicant used to wander from village to village for alms.

definition: to beg humbly for; to beseech.
example_en: He begged humbly to me for money.

definition: the light of a torch.
example_en: The light of the torch could be seen from far away on the forest path.

definition: to lift or cause to move slightly up.
example_en: He lifted his head slightly and looked.

definition: a hemispherical roof or one formed by a series of rounded arches or vaults on a round or many-sided base; a large cupola; a dome.
example_en: The palace's dome could be seen even from a distance.

definition: an inner door.
example_en: He entered inside through the inner door.

definition: a piece of stone whose surface is coarse.
example_en: A coarse-surfaced stone was used for the temple wall.

definition: the utterance in the presence of another person of a false statement or statements, damaging to a third person's character or reputation; slandering.
example_en: Slanderous talk never brings any good anywhere.

definition: offensive display of superiority or self-importance; overbearing pride; haughtiness; arrogance.
example_en: Seeing his arrogance, no one spoke.

definition: rigorous imprisonment.
example: ಆ ಕೈದಿಗೆ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಅಜ್ಜೆರೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ವಿಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The court imposed rigorous imprisonment on that prisoner.

definition: a large river.
example_en: Even in summer, that large river did not dry up.

definition: in a straight direction; unswervingly.
example_en: The arrow travelled unswervingly towards the target.

definition: (the mind) to transcend to an attributeless state.
example_en: In meditation, his mind transcended to an attributeless state.

definition: a conceiving or being conceived; the condition of being pregnant; conception.
example: ಗರ್ಭಧಾರಣ ಆದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಮನೆಯವರೆಲ್ಲ ಸಂತೋಷಪಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: Hearing the news of conception, everyone in the family was happy.

definition: the quality or state of being certain, unambiguous; unambiguousness.
example_en: An unambiguous certainty was evident in his words.

definition: to engage in a discussion or argument; to discuss; to debate.
example_en: They discussed and debated about politics.

definition: the duty or quality of a doorkeeper.
example: ಅವನ ಪಡಿವಳತನದಿಂದ ಯಾವ ಕಳ್ಳನೂ ಒಳಗೆ ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because of his doorkeeping, no thief could get inside.

definition: the sound produced by chiming bells.
example_en: A chiming sound of bells rang out from the chariot's bells.

definition: a fierce battle.
example_en: That fierce battle is described terrifyingly in the epic.

definition: a blow delivered on a vulnerable or vital part of the body.
example_en: He fell to the ground from the blow on a vital part of his body.

definition: pl. of avaḷ.
example: ಅವಳ್ದಿರ್ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದರು ಎಂದು ಹಳಗನ್ನಡ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: It is written in old Kannada poetry that they (fem. pl.) came home.

definition: the art of wrestling.
example_en: He learned the art of wrestling from his guru.

definition: to act, interact with each other.
example_en: The two interact with each other like friends.

definition: the act of twisting, wrenching of winding.
example_en: The twisting of the rope made it strong.

definition: to utter or express in a shout, as an ass.
example_en: The donkey brayed loudly in the street.

definition: a payment for the temporary possession or use of a house, land or other property, made, usually at fixed intervals, by the tenant or user to the owner; rent.
example_en: Rent must be paid for the house every month.

definition: post, mail - a) letters, papers, packages, etc. handled, transported, and delivered by the post office; b) letters, papers, etc. received or sent by a person, company, etc.
example_en: The mail arrived at the house this morning.

definition: to cause to plunder, loot.
example_en: The king caused the soldiers to plunder the village.

definition: comparatively more active, easily or readily moving; quicker; smarter.
example_en: This horse is quicker than that horse.

definition: (dial.) to blow air from the mouth (to kindle fire).
example_en: He blew air from his mouth to kindle the stove fire.

definition: (dial.) not stitched together; of a single piece (said of cloth).
example: ಆ ಸೀರೆಯ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಅಜಂಡವಾಗಿ ಒಂದೇ ತುಂಡಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That sari's cloth was unstitched, a single piece.

definition: a skilled archer.
example: ಆ ಶರಶಾಲಿ ಗುರಿಯನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಬಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಭೇದಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That skilled archer pierced the target with a single arrow.

definition: farm animals collectively, as domesticated cows, bulls, etc.; cattle.
example_en: The cowherd took the cattle to the field.

definition: the condition of things, as thread, etc. being intertwined and setting right of which is difficult.
example: ನೂಲಿನ ಗೋಜನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಲು ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ ಹಿಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: It took her an hour to untangle the knot of thread.

definition: a country that is to the north of.
example_en: They migrated here from the country to the north.

definition: the occupation of a lawyer.
example_en: He practiced law for thirty years.

definition: a short note written to help one remember something or remind one to do something; a memo or memorandum.
example_en: The secretary wrote a memorandum for the meeting.

definition: a woman (in gen.).
example_en: That woman walked carrying the child.

definition: the sum of two or more numbers; total; aggregate.
example_en: The clerk prepared the total of the account.

definition: the quality or fact of being underdeveloped (esp. in size); emaciated growth.
example: ಪೋಷಣೆ ಕೊರತೆಯಿಂದ ಆ ಮಗುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೀಚಲು ಕಂಡುಬಂತು.
example_en: Due to lack of nutrition, stunted growth was seen in that child.

definition: a long, complex sentence.
example: ಆ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಮೊದಲ ಮಹಾವಾಕ್ಯ ಓದಲು ಕಷ್ಟವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The first long sentence of that book was hard to read.

definition: a bitter enemy.
example_en: He is my bitter enemy.

definition: harsh, scorching sunlight.
example_en: The farmers grew tired in the harsh scorching sunlight.

definition: a regular and repeated circuit of (an area, town, camp, etc.) in guarding; a patrolling.
example_en: The guards were patrolling the village.

definition: not at ease with other people; shy; bashful.
example_en: That girl was shy by nature.

definition: that helps or causes (something) go up or prosper.
example_en: This medicine has a property that promotes betterment.

definition: the act of going round; a wandering, roaming.
example_en: The kite's spinning was pleasant to watch.

definition: the sleepy or half asleep eyes.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಜಾವ ಅವನ ತೂಂಕಡಿಕೆಗಣ್ಣುಗಳು ಪೂರ್ತಿ ತೆರೆಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: At dawn his sleepy eyes did not open fully.

definition: to engage in a large-scale fight; to engage in an armed fighting.
example_en: The two armies engaged in an armed fight at the border.

definition: worthless; useless.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಯಂತ್ರ ಈಗ ಲೊಡಕವಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಿದೆ.
example_en: That old machine has now become worthless.

definition: resulting from displeasure, wrath.
example_en: Everyone was startled by those words born of anger.

definition: one who makes use of medicines and treats patients; a doctor; a physician.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಅಗದಕಾರ ಮೂಲಿಕೆಗಳಿಂದ ರೋಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The village physician treats patients with herbal medicines.

definition: to devalue - a) to subject (a monetary unit or a currency) to devaluation; b) to lessen or, sometimes, annul the value, importance, etc. of.
example_en: The government decided to devalue the currency.

definition: to move around something.
example_en: The planets move around the sun.

definition: the old name for the present city, Pāṭna.
example_en: Pataliputra was a great city in ancient times.

definition: a singing of musical notes aesthetically.
example_en: The musician enthralled everyone with his aesthetic rendering of musical notes.

definition: charred meat.
example_en: The cook prepared charred meat for the kebab.

definition: to draw out to greater length; to lengthen; to elongate.
example_en: The carpenter lengthened the rope.

definition: the tree Brucea sumatrana of Simaroubaceae family.
example_en: There was a Brucea sumatrana tree in the corner of the garden.

definition: a wooden sword.
example_en: The child was playing, holding a wooden sword.

definition: a man having unaffected means of sustenance; a man well settled in life.
example_en: That well-settled man had earned respect in the town.
